judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are P2 (rank 1) Skills Objectives under the same merged Topic Area 'Geometry', so the grain matches but same-rank developmental direction would need substantive evidence. The first (Unit 10, 'Types of lines and angles') asks pupils to identify right, acute, and obtuse angles in classroom objects; the second (Unit 11, 'Square, rectangle, and triangle') asks pupils to measure and calculate the perimeter of a square, rectangle, and triangle. The second depends on linear measurement and addition of side lengths (LCs: 'measure the perimeter...', 'calculate the perimeter...'), not on angle classification, and the first does not extend into measurement, so neither direction of developmental support is justified.
